promotion_policy.tier1: Admin-confirmed current proof, preferably direct in-game evidence or authoritative official evidence for the exact proposition.
promotion_policy.tier2: Admin-confirmed official source when direct in-game proof is unavailable or the proposition is officially documented rather than visible in-game.
promotion_policy.tier3: Strong tested technical/community evidence accepted by admin.
promotion_policy.tier6: Rumor/unverified; never treated as confirmed truth.
